items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: And we're missing the drums. Joe Martin and Matt Creole. ... Joe Martin played snare and Matt Creole played the bass drum.

ctx.x: Now, which instrument did Paul Piazza play? Trumpet. Yeah.

Paul Piazza played trumpet and George Bracey was the leader. We had three trumpet. Louis Rodriguez played trumpet. Uh-huh. You see? I played clown at the end of that band. Paul Piazza, George Bracey, Joe Martin, man Creole. My brother, Joe Parker. Who else was getting this? I don't know. Yes, Clayton Brown. Clayton Brown, Popey. Came with the alto player. We had two alto, up the right alto. We had a trombone player. You know Sonny Henry. You know Sonny Henry. Sure do. Huh? I sure do. Oh, well, he played. He…
Sheikode, that's right. Sheikode played baritone. Mm-hm. Sheikode played trombone. And you had only one trombone?
